text:
maya: Heads-up: we have a new office legend — the corner ficus survived 3 waterings and a stapler incident. It has been named "Mr. Pickles". Initiation at 3pm in kitchen. :tada: :herb:
kevin: can't believe we named a plant. are we doing a playlist and a robe? 😂
eli: bring photo or it didn't happen
sophie: i'll bring the tiny paper crown. and the LED fairy lights. :crown:
jaspreet: tradition update: every new plant gets a sticker from the founding banana chair. (jk) but also we should write an oath.
maya: OATH DRAFT:
```
I, Mr. Pickles, solemnly accept potting soil, occasional water, and the crumbs of cult-latte.
May my leaves face the sun, my roots linger, and my name appear in at least 3 onboarding docs.
```
sophie: perfect. we should make a sash out of a conference badge ribbon.
kevin: photo: <https://img.redwood.example/mr-pickles.jpg> (pretend)
eli: also this is a good time to retire "Kevin's mug" nickname. :sunglasses:
jaspreet: not happening. the mug has its own lore.
deploy-bot: Heads up: company deploy 3:00-3:30pm. If ceremony runs over, please avoid blocking the oncall. :robot_face:
maya: noted—ceremony moved to 2:45. quick vows, crowns, spritz of water. :droplet:
sophie: can someone bring the tiny flag from last hackathon? it's very ceremonial.
kevin: i'll RSVP 'maybe' and bring a snack shaped like a pickle. :pickle:
eli: if we make a Mr. Pickles Slack emoji, can it be the face of our onboarding page? :eyes:
jaspreet: yes — new hire quiz question: "What's Mr. Pickles' middle name?"
maya: ANSWER: "Reginald" (voted by 3 people in kitchen)
kevin: :thumbsup: 2 — see you at 2:45
sophie: :sparkles: long live Mr. Pickles :herb:
deploy-bot: Noted. If ceremony begins during the deploy window, I'm going to post a gif of a clam. (not a threat)
